entities.name: Mārtiņš Bondars
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mārtiņš Bondars is a Latvian financier and politician. He has been a member of the Latvian parliament since 2014. Bondars previously served as chief of staff to then President of Latvia Vaira Vīķe-Freiberga and chairman of the Latvijas Krājbanka board.
